items.quote: And he charged them, and said unto them, I am to be gathered unto my people: bury me with my fathers in the cave that is in the field of Ephron the Hittite
items.claim: Jacob instructs burial with his fathers in the cave in the field of Ephron the Hittite
items.place: cave in the field of Ephron the Hittite

items.quote: In the cave that is in the field of Machpelah, which is before Mamre, in the land of Canaan, which Abraham bought with the field of Ephron the Hittite for a possession of a buryingplace
items.claim: The burial cave is in the field of Machpelah before Mamre in Canaan, which Abraham bought from Ephron the Hittite
items.place: field of Machpelah, before Mamre, land of Canaan
